visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Joeman, a man with short dark hair and a friendly expression, sits at a light-colored wooden desk in a clean, modern studio. He wears a dark blue sweatshirt with the yellow text "thisisneverthat". He holds a white and grey VR headset (Apple Vision Pro) with both hands, gesturing toward it. The background includes a blurred picture frame and warm, soft indoor lighting. (2) A macro shot of the headset's front glass panel is shown. Graphic overlays appear, displaying an Apple M2 chip icon transitioning to an Apple M5 chip icon via a glowing green arrow. The lighting is bright, highlighting the metallic and glass textures of the device. (3) A digital interface screen capture from inside the headset appears, showing a video editing software interface (DaVinci Resolve) floating in a virtual room. A hand is visible in the foreground, pointing at the windows. The virtual background is a dark, high-end apartment with a night city view. (4) Close-up shots of the headset's side profile and headband. The focus is on the grey braided fabric and the circular adjustment knob. Yellow text overlays list specifications such as 120Hz and battery life improvements. The camera pans slowly over the device's physical details. (5) Comparison sequence showing the head strap. One shot shows a single-band strap labeled "M2 Version", followed by a shot of a dual-band strap on the current model. A person wears the device, demonstrating the fit. The lighting remains consistent and bright. (6) Joeman returns to the frame, sitting at the same desk. He demonstrates the rotation of the adjustment knob on the headset's side. He uses his index finger to rotate the dial while speaking directly to the camera. The setting is the same studio from the first phase.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a first-impression review of the new M5 version of Apple Vision Pro. It highlights the significant performance jump from the M2 chip and introduces the redesigned dual-band head strap, aimed at improving user comfort for long-duration wear.
